allow: PowerShell($wc = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $html = $wc.DownloadString\("http://localhost:3000/"\); Write-Host "Status: OK"; Write-Host "Length: $\($html.Length\)"; $html.Substring\(0, 300\))

PowerShell($r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/trivia/daily" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "pokemon_name:" $r.pokemon_name; Write-Host "clue count:" $r.clues.Count; $r.clues | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  -" $_ })
